map.下降率 = 真空速 × sin(航迹角)。: Descent rate = true airspeed × sin(flight path angle).

map.按稳定进近 3° 下滑角核算下降率，匹配 ILS/目视进近。: Check the descent rate against a 3° stable approach glide path to match ILS/visual approaches.

map.：真空速 V=80 m/s、航迹角 γ=−3°。下降率 ROC = −80×si: : true airspeed V=80 m/s, flight path angle γ=−3°. Descent rate ROC = −80×sin(−3°) = −80×(−0.0523) = 4.19 m/s ≈ 825 ft/min, inside the common 700–1000 ft/min stable approach band.

map.下降率和爬升率符号相反吗？: Do descent rate and climb rate have opposite signs?
map.是，爬升为正、下降为负（按升力方向定义）。进近时关注绝对值（下降快慢），过大说明: Yes, climb is positive and descent negative (defined by the lift direction). On approach watch the absolute value (how fast the sink rate is): too large means the sink rate exceeds the standard, so reduce thrust or correct with bank.
map.真空速和地速影响下降率吗？: Do true airspeed and ground speed affect the descent rate?
map.本公式用真空速算相对空气的下沉率；相对地面的下沉还受风影响。进近监控以雷达/无线: This formula gives the sink rate relative to the air using true airspeed; sink relative to the ground is also affected by wind. Approach monitoring follows the radar / radioaltimeter descent rate.
